title: The Elevator in the Casino
content: This was really disjointed, and it's really hard to remember. There are more things that I can kind of remember that I won't really touch on, mostly because I can't remember them clearly enough to describe them in a way that makes sense. The first time i fell asleep last night, i was asleep for less than an hour before i was jerked awake panicking. Something felt really wrong but it was 2:30 in the morning so I couldn't really go anywhere to clear my head. So I went back to sleep. Then I was in the hotel/casino. One of the elevators was open, but it didn't look like a normal elevator. It looked like another room, so I stepped in. The door stayed open for a minute, then closed behind me. It was a huge elevator. There was an ornate gold and glass table, with seats that matched. Every wall had a mirror, but it seemed... Deeper than that. Like there was more in the mirror than what I could see. I didn't feel the elevator move or anything, and I didn't call a floor either, but when I stepped out I was on a different floor. This is the first time I've seen a gymnasium. It was grey, empty, but I could feel... Someone with me. I couldn't see them, it's like we were in the same place at different times kind of. I left after a bit, went back to the elevator, and this time when I got off I went into a restaurant. It was very pretty, like one of those really fancy Michelin starred restaurants that charge you 30 bucks for sparkling water infused with gold flakes. You know? Anyway I was wandering around, I could hear live piano music playing, the clink of glasses and people talking to each other. Wine glasses half filled, candles on tables lit and flickering. I couldn't see anyone, but I could feel them. If I stood next to some tables long enough I could feel them notice me too, if that... Makes sense. There's a lot of disjointed crap too, like I remember a forest, pavement, flashing lights, feeling like I was lost, but I can't place that in the casino or anything concrete.
